title: PSB Rc 98 (Lian) Rice Variety: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: PSB Rc 98 Rice Variety: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: PSB Rc 98 is an inbred rice for rainfed lowland: about 116 days and 2.6 tonnes per hectare on average. See its pest ratings and grain quality.
excerpt: PSB Rc 98 is an inbred rice variety for rainfed lowland, known locally as Lian. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 2001. It matures in about 116 days and averages 2.6 tonnes per hectare, with a top yield of 4.5 tonnes in trials.

blocks.text: How much does PSB Rc 98 yield?

On average it gives 2.6 tonnes per hectare. That is about 52 cavans of 50 kilograms of palay. It sits below the average of the 25 rainfed lowland inbreds on the list, which is 3.4 tonnes. But the top yield, 4.5 tonnes, came from a trial with good water, seed and care. So plan your costs on the average, then work toward the top with the habits in our guide to [raising rice yield per hectare](/blog/increase-rice-yield-per-hectare).
How many days does it take to mature?

It takes about 116 days from sowing to harvest. Varieties of 100 to 120 days count as short duration and 120 to 140 days as medium, so this one counts as short duration. Then harvest when 85 to 90 percent of the grains turn golden yellow. Because the day count drives every task, anee.io counts it for you from each lot's own planting day, with the [growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in its ratings. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain of a disease or a new pest population comes. So keep scouting, and use our [pest and disease finders](/features/pest-and-disease-finders) when something looks wrong.

Amylose decides how rice cooks. With high amylose, expect rice that is firm and dry, and it hardens as it cools. In fact, Filipino taste has moved from high to intermediate and low amylose rice, because people want it softer. Head rice is the share of whole grains after milling. So a higher number means fewer broken grains and a better price at the mill.

It suits rainfed lowland that depends on the rains. So wait until the rains settle before you sow the seedbed, then transplant into the puddled field. Our guide to [rice land preparation](/land-preparation/rice-land-preparation) shows each step. It is recommended for the dry season and the wet season. You can plant it dry direct seeded, transplanted or wet direct seeded. For the right month in your province, see [the best time to plant rice](/blog/best-time-to-plant-rice-philippines).

items.q: What is the local name of PSB Rc 98?
items.a: It is known as Lian. Seed sellers and agriculturists use both names, so ask for either one.

items.q: How many days does PSB Rc 98 take to harvest?
items.a: About 116 days after sowing. Then harvest when 85 to 90 percent of the grains are golden yellow.

items.q: What is the average yield of PSB Rc 98?
items.a: It averages 2.6 tonnes per hectare, about 52 cavans of 50 kilograms. The best trial reached 4.5 tonnes. Your own yield depends on water, seed, fertilizer and timing.

items.q: In which season should I plant it?
